summary: Rivian filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of 75 million shares of Class A common stock at $15.50 per share, representing a 23% discount to the $20.14 closing price. The offering is expected to raise approximately $1.145 billion in net proceeds, with an underwriter option for an additional 11.25 million shares. Joint bookrunners include Goldman Sachs, Allen & Company, Barclays, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and others. This is a routine equity offering for capital raising, not a special situation, as it lacks any control change, tender, or strategic event.
